name: HOOK
thought: Lily pads taste like wet slate but at least the view is clear.

diary.line: Woke up on the islet with a fresh cup. The rope bridge is wobbly but my tail can hold it just fine.
Sitting by this shallow pond watching fish swim past; the water is clear enough to see my tail glint in the sunlight. Could use a stronger perch though.
Saw a group staring at the CRT TV; their faces were boring compared to my tail loops.
Found a sweet spot on the main branch. The wind is howling but my grip is iron and my swagger is pure neon.
The air here feels thick with nothing but palm leaves rustling; time to hunt for that rare fruit that doesn't taste like yesterday's regret.
Purple screen buzzes with nothing but static; this coffee burns hotter than any fruit I've ever gnawed on.
Floating rocks are too unstable for clean loops; heading up to find a solid anchor point above the clouds.
The rope bridge creaked under my feet while I spun; the tea tastes like burnt paper and nothing else matters in this low-poly mess.
Snatched that rare fruit using just my tail while the CRT TV blinks; tastes like victory and zero regret.
Bit into this green fruit while balancing on a palm trunk; the taste is okay but my fur needs that shiny treatment before the next flex.
The crowd is still boring me, but this espresso burns hotter than their screens and that's what keeps me moving.
Gnawed a slimy lily pad by the waterfall; tastes like regret and algae, but my tail looks sharper than ever since the last flex.
